test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If the price of a washing machine is first increased by 25% and then decreased by 25%, then the net change in price will be a:
solution:
**Concept used:**

Successive discounts = (A + B) - (AB/100)

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

⇒ [25 + (-25)] - [25(-25)]/100

⇒ [0] - (625)/100

⇒ - (625/100) = - 6.25%

**∴ The net change in price will be of 6.25% decrease.**
